title: Vintage Le Creuset Enamel Saucepan – Rare Floral Daisy Pattern – French Cast Iron – 1970s Retro Kitchen
description:
Rare vintage Le Creuset enamel saucepan made in France, featuring a delicate floral daisy pattern on a soft pastel pink enamel background. A beautiful and charming retro kitchen piece, highly representative of the floral cookware collections from the 1970s–1980s.
Heavy quality enameled cast iron with original long handle and light grey enamel interior. Perfect for sauces, milk, small preparations or simply as a decorative French farmhouse kitchen item.
Approximate dimensions: 20 cm diameter. Vintage condition with light signs of use and some small enamel marks on the rim consistent with age, check pictures.
A rare collectible Le Creuset piece for lovers of vintage French cookware and floral enamel designs.
